Hand 18: Villain SB limped with Td 6c. Hero BB checked (5s 9h). Flop Ts 8s 3c: villain bet 3 with top pair (Td), hero folded. Villain +2.
Hand 19: Villain BB held Td 2s — hero SB folded 2h 5c preflop. No action from villain.
Hand 20: Villain SB limped with 7d Kh. Hero BB checked (Ad 4s). Flop Td 9s 6h: villain bet 3 with K-high air (pure bluff), hero folded. Villain +2.
